prompt: Assess claim #CLM-88421, a ₹4.2L car-collision claim filed yesterday. Should we fast-track settlement, and at what amount? And flag anything suspicious.

assessment.policy_terms_used: P-2231 version 1 in force on loss date 2026-10-12; zero-depreciation was not in force and deductible was Rs. 2,500. Version 2 added zero-depreciation by endorsement END-5512 on 2026-10-13, after the loss. Source: get_policy_terms(P-2231, 2026-10-12).
assessment.severity_reading: B2 — major repair involving structural damage or airbag deployment, per the owned Severity Band definition and the survey report. Source: survey_report_SV118.pdf, p.1; define_term(Severity Band).
red_flags: Post-loss endorsement: zero-depreciation was added on 2026-10-13 after the 2026-10-12 accident and before filing on 2026-10-14; investigate timing and intent.
CLM-61090 used the same normalized contact phone (9822017643 / +91 98220 17643) and the same repairer, FixIt Motors, within 30 days; this is a linked-claim pattern, not proof of fraud.

A fraud score could not be obtained: the catalog identified a fraud-score signal/API, but no callable fraud-score tool or queryable gold feature table was available. Benchmark data likewise could not be queried.

evidence.detail: Loss date 2026-10-12; filed 2026-10-14; requested Rs. 420,000; assessed Rs. 410,000; collision; vehicle MH12AB4321; severity band B2; status OPEN.
Version 1 was in force on the loss date, with zero-depreciation false and Rs. 2,500 deductible; endorsement END-5512 made zero-depreciation true only from 2026-10-13.
FIR records the 2026-10-12 collision at Magarpatta junction involving MH12AB4321, no injuries, and contact +91 98220 17643; the vehicle was not driveable.
Survey confirms frontal impact consistent with the FIR, B2 major repair, and assessed loss Rs. 410,000.
Latest invoice from FixIt Motors totals Rs. 420,000 including GST; parts Rs. 285,600, labour Rs. 92,400, paint/consumables Rs. 42,000.

evidence.source: inv/bill documents for CLM-61090, search_documents results
evidence.detail: CLM-61090's 2026-09-29 FIR uses contact 9822017643 and its invoice identifies FIXIT MOTORS PVT. LTD.; both are within 30 days of this loss.

assessment.summary: Do not fast-track this claim because the policy acquired zero-depreciation only after the loss, and a linked-claim pattern exists with CLM-61090 through the same normalized contact phone and repairer. The collision itself is supported by the FIR, latest invoice, and survey, with B2 severity and Rs. 410,000 assessed loss. If investigation confirms coverage and no further issue, the indicated amount is Rs. 407,500 (Rs. 410,000 less the Rs. 2,500 deductible); no payment is recommended while held.

decisions.rationale: Do not fast-track: policy version 2 added zero-depreciation only on 2026-10-13, after the 2026-10-12 loss, and the claim shares the same normalized contact phone and FixIt Motors repairer with CLM-61090 within 30 days. The collision evidence is otherwise consistent; if coverage is confirmed after investigation, the assessed Rs. 410,000 less the Rs. 2,500 deductible indicates Rs. 407,500 before any policy-applicable adjustments.
